options.content: Direct-source operational estimates, not reconciled campaign results. All includes idle hosts; select the intended encoder/run and one chain. Component IDs must be unique within that chain. Current identity joins cannot isolate historical samples across a restart. Missing data is not zero. NIC and shard bytes include erasure amplification and retries. Compare reporting-source coverage with inventory before treating totals as complete. Optional host sampler metrics require separate instrumentation.
